name: SaunaLife G6 | 5-Person Outdoor Cabin Sauna | Pre-Assembled
description: Description You know the feeling of a long day that never quite ends. Work bleeds into evening, screens follow you home, and by the time you're supposed to unwind, you're still wired. The gym sauna helps when it's working and not crowded, but it closes early, feels lukewarm, or has a "no water on rocks" sign taped to the wall. You know what real heat should feel like, but your options keep falling short. The SaunaLife GARDEN-Series Model G6 is a fully assembled outdoor sauna cabin that arrives ready to become part of your property and your daily rhythm. Handcrafted in Northern Europe where sauna bathing is woven into everyday life, this isn't a weekend assembly project or a structure you'll spend months planning and permitting. It's a complete outdoor room, delivered on a flatbed truck, that transforms your backyard into a private wellness sanctuary within days of arrival. Step inside and you'll find premium furniture-grade alder interiors with two-tier benches, a full wall of dual-pane tempered glass that frames your yard, and dotless LED lighting that creates ambient warmth without harsh glare. The cabin's massive 7-1/16 inch insulated walls hold heat steadily through cold months while keeping the interior quiet and controlled. Bluetooth speakers let you stream music or meditation tracks. A built-in drainage system and slanted roof with rainwater control mean this cabin is engineered for year-round outdoor use, not seasonal storage. This is designed for up to five people, but most owners find themselves using it alone or with one other person regularly. It becomes the place where you go to stop thinking, to feel your shoulders drop, to let the heat do what scrolling and television never can. It's not a luxury in the indulgent sense. It's infrastructure for mental clarity and physical recovery, built to last decades. The Model G6 sits between two extremes. On one side, there's the idea of designing and building a custom sauna structure from scratch, complete with architects, permits, contractors, framing, insulation, months of decision-making, and costs that can easily exceed $50,000 to $60,000 for comparable quality and size. On the other side, there are barrel kits or prefab boxes that arrive in pieces, require full weekend assembly, and often suffer from thin walls, cold feet, or uneven heat distribution at a fraction of the price but also a fraction of the quality and longevity. This cabin is neither. It's fully assembled at the factory by craftsmen who build saunas daily in a region where sauna quality is not negotiable. You're not managing a construction project. You're not troubleshooting instructions or making up solutions for missing hardware. The structure arrives intact. Your responsibility is preparing a level foundation, arranging equipment for offloading, and hiring a licensed electrician to connect the heater and controls. That's standard for any permanent outdoor structure in this class, and it's far simpler than coordinating a months-long build. Why do you think homeowners who finally install a real outdoor sauna cabin stop talking about the gym entirely? Because once you own the space, the ritual becomes effortless. No driving, no waiting, no lukewarm disappointment. Just consistent heat, privacy, and a structure that holds its value as part of your home. The investment here is substantial and straightforward. You're paying once for a handcrafted structure that becomes a fixed element of your property, like a pool house or a garden pavilion, but one that you'll use multiple times per week for years. This is a considered purchase for homeowners who understand the difference between cost and value, and who are investing in long-term wellness infrastructure rather than temporary solutions. A few months after installation, the pattern settles in. You finish work in the late afternoon, change, and head outside while the cabin heats. Within 45 minutes it reaches 190°F. You sit on the upper bench, throw water on the stones, and feel the steam rise around you. The engineered ventilation system brings in fresh air without drafts. The glass wall in front of you shows your backyard, not a locker room. The only sound is the occasional hiss of water on rocks and whatever you've chosen to stream through the speakers. Twenty minutes later, you step out into cool air feeling lighter, quieter, ready for your evening instead of carrying the weight of the day through dinner and into restless sleep. That's what this cabin is built to deliver. Not a fantasy, just a reliable outdoor room where heat, privacy, and routine combine into something you'll use year-round because it's yours. Features Fully assembled outdoor sauna cabin – arrives complete with no kit assembly required, so you avoid weeks of construction and troubleshooting. Premium furniture-grade alder interior with two-tier benches – alder absorbs and releases moisture evenly, preventing warping and staying cool to the touch even at high temperatures, so you sit comfortably without towels. Finely sawn spruce exterior, painted black – traditional Finnish construction with a modern aesthetic that integrates cleanly into contemporary landscapes. Full front wall of double-glazed, tempered glass – provides panoramic outdoor views and natural light while maintaining thermal efficiency, so the cabin feels open without losing heat. Insulated glass door with black wood frame and aluminum handle – dual-pane construction keeps heat inside while the clear glass maintains visual connection to your surroundings. Built-in Bluetooth audio system with speakers – stream music, podcasts, or guided meditations directly from your phone without additional installation. Dotless dimmable white LED lighting (IP67 rated) – waterproof and heat-resistant LED strips behind the backrest and under benches create ambient lighting you control from your phone or remote. Massive 7-1/16 inch wall thickness – heavily insulated walls provide superior heat retention and acoustic isolation, so the cabin reaches temperature faster and stays quieter inside. Engineered ventilation system – intake vent positioned beside the heater and exhaust vent high on the opposite wall ensures continuous fresh air circulation as recommended by heater manufacturers, so you never need to open the door during use. Slanted roof with integrated rainwater control system – channels water to a rear gutter and prevents structural water damage over years of outdoor exposure. PVC subfloor with removable alder floor grate – easy to clean, durable, and allows interior water drainage through a built-in floor drain beneath the heater. Designed for up to 5 people – spacious upper and lower benches accommodate groups, though most users enjoy solo or paired sessions. Handcrafted in Northern Europe – built in Finland or Estonia by sauna specialists in regions where daily sauna use has refined construction standards for generations. What's Included? Model G6 fully assembled outdoor sauna cabin Upper and lower alder wood benches (installed) Alder floor grate over PVC subfloor Integrated rainwater control system with gutter and drainage Pre-wired, waterproof LED lighting system (IP67 rated) Built-in Bluetooth speaker system Interior water drainage system with floor drain Black aluminum door handle (19.68" L x 1.26" diameter) Installation manual Electrical installation guide Specifications Specification Details Model GARDEN-Series Model G6 Capacity Up to 5 people Exterior Materials Finely sawn spruce, painted black Interior Materials Premium furniture-grade alder Interior Dimensions 71.5" D x 80" W x 80.25" H Exterior Dimensions 83" D x 95" W x 96" H Wall Thickness 7-1/16" (180mm) insulated construction Front Window 79.92" W, full-wall clear tempered dual-pane glass (0.94" thick) Door Clear tempered dual-pane insulated glass with black wooden frame Door Handle 19.68" L x 1.26" diameter, black aluminum Lighting Waterproof dotless white LED (IP67 rated), dimmable, phone/remote controlled Audio System Built-in Bluetooth speakers (1 pair) Flooring PVC subfloor with alder wood grate, built-in drainage Ventilation Intake vent beside heater, exhaust vent high on opposite wall Roof Slanted with integrated rainwater control and gutter system Electrical Requirements Heater requires dedicated 240V circuit installed by licensed electrician; 120V for lighting and controls Shipping Dimensions 86" L x 98" W x 100" H Shipping Weight 2,756 lbs (1,250 kg) Country of Origin Northern Europe (Finland/Estonia) Installation The SaunaLife Model G6 is delivered fully assembled, which eliminates the multi-week construction timeline and assembly complexity of traditional builds or kit saunas. However, proper site preparation and final connections are required to ensure safe, long-term performance. Foundation and Placement The foundation must be level, stable, and positioned at least 3 inches higher than surrounding ground to prevent water pooling. Recommended foundation: concrete blocks or compacted gravel strips that distribute the cabin's weight evenly. Place geotextile fabric under the cabin to prevent grass, weeds, or ground moisture from accumulating beneath the structure. You may also place the cabin on an existing terrace or paved surface, provided the surface is level and elevated above ground level. Post-Delivery Final Assembly The cabin arrives intact, but the following components require installation after delivery: Parapet metal trim on the roof Decorative base boards Outdoor lighting fixtures (120V) Sauna heater and control unit (requires licensed electrician) Rainwater drainage routing Electrical cabinet for lighting and controls Electrical Work The sauna heater requires a dedicated 240V circuit and hardwired connection installed by a licensed electrician. This is standard for all traditional sauna heaters and ensures safe, reliable operation. The cabin's pre-wired lighting and Bluetooth systems use 120V and connect to the outdoor electrical cabinet. Topture provides detailed electrical installation guides, and our team can answer technical questions to help your electrician complete the work efficiently. Moving the Cabin (If Needed) If you need to relocate the cabin on your property in the future, two methods are available: Lifting from above: Use the lifting hooks located in each corner of the roof. Lifting from below: Use a forklift, taking care to avoid the drainage pipe underneath the structure. Both methods require professional equipment and operators experienced with structures of this size and weight. Shipping The SaunaLife Model G6 ships via flatbed truck to the contiguous United States. This is a specialized delivery that requires coordination and preparation, but it's standard for fully assembled outdoor structures in this class, and Topture works closely with customers to ensure smooth delivery. Shipping Details Flat rate shipping: $1,990 to the contiguous United States; $2,490 to Canada. Method: Flatbed truck with scheduled delivery appointment. Packaging: The cabin arrives fully assembled on a wooden pallet, encased in protective wooden crating. Dimensions: 86" L x 98" W x 100" H Weight: 2,756 lbs (1,250 kg) Offloading Requirements The customer is responsible for offloading the cabin with a forklift or crane. This is necessary due to the structure's size and weight, and it's standard procedure for outdoor cabins, sheds, and similar structures. The flatbed driver provides delivery only and limited on-site assistance but cannot move the cabin to its final placement location. Before your sauna ships, Topture or the distributor will often contact you to discuss delivery logistics, confirm access to your property, and address any site-specific challenges. This ensures you have time to arrange forklift or crane rental and prepare the foundation site. Many customers work with local equipment rental companies or landscape contractors who routinely handle this type of offloading. Remote or Complex Locations On rare occasions, remote delivery areas or locations with restricted access (narrow driveways, steep grades, limited truck turnaround space) may require additional delivery coordination or fees. Topture will work with you to identify any potential complications early and find solutions before the cabin ships. Outside Contiguous U.S. For deliveries to Alaska, Hawaii, or international locations, request a freight quote by contacting contact@topture.com .
